visual_language.direction: Windows 95 desktop chrome aesthetic, beveled 3D gray button-face panels, navy gradient title bars, pixel typography accents, every slide as a software window with group boxes and status bars, nostalgic CRT software deck

content_review.reviewer_note: 结构完整（负面约束+密度映射在案）：候选晋升，需 U3 语义审阅补主题绑定与特征后转 active

legacy_payload.best_for: 以 Win95 系统界面语汇——3D 凸起灰面、海军蓝标题栏、像素字——把每页做成一扇运行在 CRT 上的软件窗口;适合retro gaming pitch, Y2K brand, creator portfolio (90s aesthetic), tech-history talk
legacy_payload.visual_direction: Windows 95 desktop chrome aesthetic, beveled 3D gray button-face panels, navy gradient title bars, pixel typography accents, every slide as a software window with group boxes and status bars, nostalgic CRT software deck

canvas.background: Windows 95 system palette: 3D-button gray, navy title bars, pixel-perfect inset/outset borders(主锚 #C0C0C0,light 底)
canvas.composition: 软件窗口即版式:标题栏 + 客户区 + 状态条三段

color_palette.rule: Windows 95 system palette: 3D-button gray, navy title bars, pixel-perfect inset/outset borders, no anti-aliasing aesthetic;锚点 #C0C0C0/#000080/#1084D0/#000000

typography.title: Press Start 2P 标题字族;8-bit pixel display + Microsoft system sans + DOS terminal mono
typography.body: MS Sans Serif 正文字族,行距宽绰

layout_patterns: 每页一扇窗口:海军蓝 #000080 标题栏 + 灰面 #C0C0C0 客户区 + 楼梯状像素边缘的内外凸双边框(stair-stepped pixel edges),内容即窗口部件
章节页 = 满屏对话框:大标题 + 按钮组导航(短文案按钮 OK / CANCEL / RETRY / SCAN) + 图标位
数据页 = 窗口内分组框 + 状态条,DOS 绿/砖红/芥末黄仅作状态文字色
像素字(Press Start 2P/VT323)只做怀旧标点,正文走系统无衬线
信息块标题写成系统文件名式短文案:PROBLEMS.EXE / METHOD.PNG / FIX_IT.bat 式语义文件名命名每个内容模块
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: 每页一扇窗口:海军蓝 #000080 标题栏 + 灰面 #C0C0C0 客户区 + 楼梯状像素边缘的内外凸双边框,内容即窗口部件
negative_prompt: Decks that need to read as modern, elegant, or institutionally credible — the Win95 chrome will always read as a costume.
no frosted translucent glass panels, deep soft drop shadows, or soft 3D bevel effects (neumorphism) — strictly hard-edged Win95 chrome
no smooth anti-aliased curves; keep chunky pixel edges
not for institutional finance, healthcare or formal luxury gravitas
